messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we landed a change to the internal routing policy API in staging: endpoint moved from /v1/policies to /internal/routing/policies and added a top-level "quota_profile" field. This will impact SDKs that construct policy payloads. Can we coordinate a non-breaking rollout?
aj: Do we have the exact schema for "quota_profile"? Is it just a string ref or an inline object?
maria: It's an object for now, schema sketch:
```
quota_profile: {
  id: "string",
  max_qps: number,
  burst: number,
  priority: "low"|"normal"|"high"
}
```
Sanju: If SDKs expect the old v1 body, they'll 400. Are we planning an alias route or backwards compat in the service?
ben: Our dashboard code also POSTs to /v1/policies from the console. We should avoid breaking the console flow during rollout.
phil: Suggestion: add a compatibility shim that accepts both routes and normalizes payloads server-side, plus emit a deprecation warning header `X-Deprecation-Warning` so SDKs can log it. Then we can require SDK bumps in a later window.
sdk-bot: Migration checklist (auto): 1) Accept alias route, 2) Parse quota_profile object if present, 3) Emit telemetry event `sdk.policy_migration_warning` when header seen, 4) Add opt-in flag `use_internal_policy_api`.
aj: That sounds fine. For TS/Python/Go, opt-in flag may be exposed as client config. We should standardize name: `internalRouting: true`?
Sanju: Opt-in is good. But customers using Private deployment might never get shim. Need to ensure on-prem packages include shim or SDKs can fallback to old route.
ben: Console team can gate the new UI behind a feature flag and keep using old POST for now. When shim is removed, we'll flip.
phil: Rollout plan idea: 1) Deploy shim + header (1 week), 2) Push SDK patch that logs warning when header present (canary to early adopters), 3) Add opt-in config and docs, 4) After 3 weeks, begin deprecation window and notify customers, 5) Remove old route after 8 weeks.
ops-bot: Telemetry note: please add a metric count for requests hitting alias route vs internal route (`routing_policy.route_variant`) and tag by tenant. Also log the presence/absence of quota_profile.
maria: I'll open a PR to add the shim and header. Can SDK leads review the client changes? Need small breaking-change policy doc to approve the real migration timeline.
ben: I'll coordinate with Console to add feature flag and hold UI deploy until shim is live.
aj: I'll draft SDK PRs (TS/Py/Go) that add the opt-in config and warning log. Posting link when ready.
maria: Thanks — TL;DR: implement shim + header, SDK opt-in + warning, telemetry metric. We'll sync tomorrow at 10am to lock dates. :thumbsup:
